subject: general
question:
Select the option in which the number-pair shares the same relationship as that shared by the following number-pair.

61 : 97
solution:
The logic followed here is :-

61 : 97

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/91009ab69d06260841b6d7a03eafc22a7489ac834e770f5c70f953e6787b5acb.png] 

Similarly,

46 : 78

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/811c92c7a7747da3a7d8a723f2130a4b349165c6a8d181d12b8753b84bb36124.png] 

Hence, the correct answer is **"46 : 78".**

** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] __Alternate Method__** Logic: (Number)² - 3

61 : 97

61 → 8² - 3 = 64 - 3 = 61,

97 → 102 - 3 = 100 - 3 = 97,

Similarly,

46 : 78

46 → 72 - 3 = 49 - 3 = 46,

78 → 92 - 3 = 81 - 3 = 78.

Hence, the correct answer is **"Option 3"**.
